title: answers.jsonl — NeVA Gujarati Q/A extraction
description: One Gujarati NeVA question PDF split into question and answer halves via the two-column layout. quality records the trust level of the text this record was built from: clean (metadata subject found verbatim), repaired (found after a reference-calibrated glyph repair), ocr (the text layer failed the reference check and a rasterize-and-OCR re-read passed it), low (failed the reference check and was not recovered), unknown (no reference available). text_source says which read the record came from.

text_source.description: Which read produced this record. `ocr` only where the embedded text layer failed the reference check AND the OCR re-read passed it — an OCR pass that also failed never overwrites the record.
